review.headline: Tempo session completed as prescribed: 5 km at 4:36/km against a 4:37/km target, with easy warm-up and cool-down.
observations: Warm-up and cool-down each 2 km at 5:45/km, inside the 5:11-6:13 easy band, with HR 136-140.
Tempo block held 4:36/km across all five km splits, 1 s/km inside target, with steady avg HR 163.
Efficiency 1.30 matches the 2026-11-03 tempo (1.30) and is well above the 2026-11-10 session (1.09), which was cut short at 6 km.
Full 9.0 km in 2760 s, with the structure of the planned session carried out.
flags: No RPE or athlete note logged, so effort is judged only from pace and HR.
ATL 55.5 is above CTL 47.2 (TSB -4.3), so fatigue is building.
Week 3 shows 9.0 of 43.4 planned km, and no runs are logged after this session through 2026-11-25.
CTL has fallen 7.2 over the last 7 days, so fitness is trending down during the gap.
